short.text: Tyler Shatley signed with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie in 2014 and joined the practice squad after being waived at the final roster cut. A converted defensive lineman who played guard and center at Clemson, he brings strength to the interior line. He has a short history on the offensive line, and his technique and his snap and call operation at center need the most work.
